reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker recommends buying LUNA with a possible 10x return and urges viewers to act quickly on a UST day-trade opportunity while claiming a 20% gain and rapid recovery to one dollar. The speaker also directs viewers to deposit UST into Anchor Protocol, sign up for an exchange, and stake LUNA in association with stated APR rewards. Although framed as technical analysis and without established completed transactions, these repeated audience-facing financial recommendations are paired with unusually strong return claims.

citations.quote: today I wanted to cover some technical analysis on the terraluna token
anything between the $5 and the $16 price point is a great entry point for you to buy the Luna token.
This is definitely a long term hold and a way you can 10x your money in a simple swing trade.
So, again, this is a beautiful swing trade for you to jump into, with potentially 20% gain to the upside simply for taking advantage of its depegging.
And I do recommend you act fast, because stable coins on sale don't last very long.

opening.argument: The presentation is framed as technical analysis and a personal forecast, not a promise of a certain outcome: the speaker says “I think” and describes a “potential” return. The discussion also acknowledges substantial downside, including a sell-off and a broken support level, so the outlook is presented against visible risk rather than as a risk-free investment. The UST discussion identifies a depeg and relies on chart interpretation and a recovery thesis; that thesis may be overconfident, but the evidence supports reading the video as risky market commentary, not proof of a deceptive scheme.

citations.quote: today I wanted to cover some technical analysis on the terraluna token and explain why I think
taraluna has had a massive sell-off the past month and is down over 80 percent from its previous all-time high
unfortunately luna was unable to hold support and it broke to the downside
the UST stable coin likes to maintain its value up here of $1 running across pretty consistent throughout

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening points to the 10x and 20% claims and the instruction to act fast. Those are forceful forecasts, but the cited language calls the LUNA return a “way you can” achieve it and the UST return “potentially” 20%; it does not establish a guaranteed result. The same analysis openly describes the depeg and a sharp decline. The cited exchange, staking, and Anchor mentions do not by themselves establish that viewers were asked to send funds to the speaker or that any promised return was assured.

citations.quote: This is definitely a long term hold and a way you can 10x your money in a simple swing trade.
with potentially 20% gain to the upside simply for taking advantage of its depegging.
stablecoins have lost their peg at the dollar and it is now trending in the 83 cent range.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the claims potential does not make the recommendation cautious: the speaker says there is “nowhere else to go, but up,” calls the trade beautiful, and urges viewers to act fast. Acknowledging a prior decline does not neutralize confidence in a recovery, especially when the video describes the trade as a way to 10x and directs viewers toward yield on UST.

citations.quote: oversold But recovery to the upside, recovery to the upside, and again today Oversold but recovery to the upside it dipped here and nowhere else to go, but up back to it's one dollar price point
So, again, this is a beautiful swing trade for you to jump into, with potentially 20% gain to the upside simply for taking advantage of its depegging.
And I do recommend you act fast, because stable coins on sale don't last very long.

opening.argument: The core format is an explanation of chart-based reasoning: the speaker walks through support, RSI, volume nodes, and the relationship he sees between Bitcoin and altcoins. The displayed frames show trading charts with marked levels and indicators, consistent with that analysis. Viewers can dispute the interpretation, but a bullish technical forecast is still investment commentary; the supplied material does not establish that the chart discussion is a fabricated transaction or that the speaker controls the assets being discussed.

citations.quote: So with Bitcoin being the leader of all the cryptocurrencies, every other altcoin underneath it will follow its price action, including Terra Luna.
when it comes to technical analysis what we want to pay close attention to is the rsi which is your relative strength index
another level of support can be seen by using the volume profile tool

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening cites buy, trade, and deposit recommendations, but that does not erase the explanatory structure: the speaker shows how he interprets support, oversold readings, and volume nodes before stating his view. Nor does the “act fast” line prove a deceptive mechanism; the material presents a time-sensitive market thesis, not a demonstrated completed transaction or an established guaranteed result.

citations.quote: when it comes to technical analysis what we want to pay close attention to is the rsi which is your relative strength index
so on here you have your volume nodes on the right hand side on the y axis and this illustrates at which point investors were buying the LUNA token

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The charts are not merely neutral instruction: the speaker applies them directly to recommend buying LUNA, predicts a return to its prior high, and pitches a UST trade as an opportunity. An instructional format cannot settle the nature of the audience-facing claims when the analysis culminates in specific purchase and yield recommendations.

citations.quote: anything between the $5 and the $16 price point is a great entry point for you to buy the Luna token.
eventually revisit its all-time high of $121 up here.
Anchor Protocol on Tera Luna E to 18.6% APR simply for depositing the UST stable coin

opening.argument: The video names ordinary third-party services and explains where the speaker says the assets can be purchased or staked. It does not show a request for viewers’ credentials, a payment to the speaker, or a downline arrangement; the supplied transcript instead names Kraken, Crypto.com, and Anchor Protocol. Those details can be criticized as promotion, and the returns may be unreliable, but the evidence does not establish that the creator is operating a fraudulent deposit scheme or that any service is safe. The case is better understood as aggressive commentary about external products and markets.

citations.quote: for American customers both the luna token and UST is available on the kraken exchange
you can also stake the Luna token on Kraken for up to four point seven five percent APR a year in rewards
Anchor Protocol on Tera Luna E to 18.6% APR simply for depositing the UST stable coin

rebuttal.rebuttal: The recommendations and return claims warrant scrutiny, but the cited material identifies outside exchanges and a named protocol; it does not show the creator collecting deposits or credentials. The opening’s point about a “deposit” describes the proposed use of Anchor, not evidence that funds flow to the speaker. A risky or misleading promotion is not, on this record alone, proof of the specific fraudulent mechanism alleged.

citations.quote: you can also stake the Luna token on Kraken for up to four point seven five percent APR a year in rewards
simply for depositing the UST stable coin

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A creator need not personally collect deposits for the video to promote a risky financial offer. The speaker urges buying a token, directs viewers to an exchange, and recommends depositing UST for a stated APR while describing the process as simple and automatic. The lack of a credential request or direct payment does not answer whether the investment solicitation is deceptive.
